camera.name: RevisionNative_desk
camera.sourceClippingMethod: Explicit near plane on the derived source camera; unchanged across the bounded rig.

radianceCapture.fullFrameResampling: Scene-linear area average over the complete overscan frame; no crop
radianceCapture.denoising: OpenImageDenoise HIGH/ACCURATE with albedo and normal guides; independent full-resolution bounded-memory postprocess, not an in-scene full-buffer denoise

denoisingEvidence.filterRowOrder: Cycles bottom-up; normalized EXR rows reversed before filtering, all output rows reversed back to top-down EXR

independentBaseCapture.note: Retained raw capture only; delivered center base/detail instead share the 6144x3456/256spp EXR.

views.baseRadianceMethod: Scene-linear area-average the exact full overscan center EXR; no independent 32spp image or native crop at initial load.

detail.method: One independently rendered source perspective camera, with source-owned geometry/materials/lights.

sourceProvenance.sourceGeometryLighting: Original furniture, room, materials and light parameters unchanged; new source-prop copies and camera-only world documented.

artDirection.changes: Relative to v4: eye exactly 1cm lower, green pen moved onto bare tabletop along book left edge. All other prop transforms, focal length, and camera orientation unchanged.

supportCorrection.meshMethod: Evaluated source collection instance triangles in isolated scene; upward raycast finds actual undersides, downward BVH raycast actual tabletop/stack support. Includes all vertex penetration checks. 0.1mm contact tolerance avoids z-fighting.

seatEye.lookDirection: Chair local +Y with 17-degree natural downward head pitch; no own backrest in front.

bookStackRevision.artDirection: Remove slab-like beige duplicate. Three compact source-zapBook geometry variants, visible paper pages/spines/curled covers, different thin thicknesses, muted clay/sage and original blue; no external assets or fake text added.

placements.sourceGeometry: Original CC0 zapBook cover/spine and pages meshes reused; only proportional dimensions and two plain local cover materials derived.

detailDepth.method: One-sample source Cycles axial-Z at exactly matching radiance matrices and near planes.

flash.method: Cycles isolated CameraFlash light group, full-frame OIDN with normal/albedo guides; no ambient subtraction.

focus.method: Top-down OpenImageIO actual validated camera-Z EXR, native1280 coordinates mapped through exact6144 overscan crop
focus.subject: Main blue textbook cover center
focus.reason: Formal camera-Z cover-center ROI median .4538199m; nearest pencil is not the focus target. The website retains teaching DOF and user-adjustable focus.

baseEV.evidence: Formal center AgX display exposure0/gamma1, original unoccupied classroom lighting unchanged; default f/8, 0.25s, ISO100.
